c74object.name: evi_overdrive_env
c74object.digest: evieve Gen Object. Anti-aliased passive tanh-like input/output saturation with optional envelope follower
c74object.description:
evi_overdrive_env is an abstraction for using inside gen~ or GenExpr.
evi_overdrive_env.gendsp requires the GenExpr file(s):
evi_saturators.genexpr, evi_env.genexpr
evi_overdrive_env is also available in MSP as: evi.overdrive.env~.
A memoryless nonlinear approximation with antiderivative and oversampled processing. Can handle high gain input and remains well anti-aliased. An optional envelope follower allows for dynamic saturation.

geninlet.name: input
geninlet.digest: Signal. Audio input to be overdriven.

geninlet.name: gain
geninlet.digest: (linear gain 1..100 post env foll) @default 1 @min 1 @max 100. Apply gain to engage nonlinearity, applied post envelope detection and pre saturator.

attribute.name: aa
attribute.description: The 'aa' ('Anti-Aliasing) method used. 0=Adaa1, 1=Adaa1 2x oversampled, 2=Adaa1 4x oversampled, 3=Adaa2 (default), 4=Adaa2 2x oversampled, 5=Adaa2 4x oversampled. 0..5 does not necessarily mean increasing in quality, it really depends on your audio input material. Experimentation is encouraged.

attribute.name: follow
attribute.description: Engage an envelope follower on the input which dynamically controls gain into the saturation stage.

attribute.name: hfcompensate
attribute.description: The object provides a high frequency compensation 'decorelation' filter on its output for restoring the reduced high frequency response that can occur with this type of anti-aliasing, especially when utilising the oversampling options (as opposed to just using pure 'adaa'). Experiment with turning this on to improve high frequencies (default on).
